paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Pharoah kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichi in chi in ‘Toupa’n hichi in achi, ka nna ahon sepsak theihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
Amau paisak na nialleh, ngai in, ukengte in na gam tengteng ka gawt ding hi.

Lui in ukeng atam a tam hon suahkhe ding ua, huaite ahong paitou ding ua, na inn ah ahong lut ding ua, na lupna dantan sung ah, na lupna tung ah, na sikhate inn ah, na mite tung ah, na thuk ah leh na tangbuang bawlna ah ahong om ding uh.
Ukengte nang tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah ahong kaltou ding uhi," chi in.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, luinak neite tung leh luite tung leh tuichinte tung ah na chiangkhun toh na khut lik inla, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte hon paitousak in, chi in," achi hi.
Aaron in Aigupta luite tung ah akhut alik a; ukengte ahong paitou ua, Aigupta gamsung atuamta uhi.
Huchi mah bang in mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un ahih ua, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte ahon latou uhi.
Huaitak in Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Kei leh ka mite a pan ukengte alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA ngen un. TOUPA kiang a kithoihna abawltheihna ding un, mite ka paisak ding," achi hi.

Mosi in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka tung ah ki-uangsak in; nang a ding leh na sikhate a ding leh na mite a ding leh nang leh na innte a pan, tui a a-omtheihna ding ua ukengte lakmangna dia chikchiang a hon ngetsak ding ka hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Zingchiang in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na thu bang hi hen. TOUPA ka Pathian bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
Nang leh na innte uh leh na sikhate leh na mite a pan ukengte apawtkhe ding ua; lui kia ah a-omta ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi leh Aaron apaikhia ua; Pharaoh gawtna ding a ukengte akoih tungtang ah TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi thu bang in ahihta a; innte leh khuate a pan leh loute a pan ukengte asita uhi.
Huchi in akaikhawm ua, avum ua, gam a-uihta hi.
Himahleh Pharaoh in atung azangta chih atheih in, alungtang akhauhsak a; amaute angaikhe kei; TOUPA gen bang in.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, na chiangkhun lik inla, gam a leivui sat in, Aigupta gam pumpi a hik ahong omtheihna ding un, chi in,” achi hi.
Huchibang in ahih ua; Aaron in achiangkhun toh akhut alik a, lei a leivui asat a, mi tung leh sa tung ah hik ahong omta a; gam a leivui teng Aigupta gam pumpi ah hik ahong suak vekta hi.
Mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi un hikte omsak ding in huchibang in ahih ua, himahleh ahihthei kei uh. Huchi in mi tung leh sa tung ah hik a-omta hi.
Huaitak in mitkhialdawi tawite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai Pathian khutzung ahi," achi uhi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh in. Ngai in, tuilam zuan a, ahong paikhiak in akiang ah, 'Hichibang in TOUPA'n achi, ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.
heading: Thouhonpite

paite: Huchi lou a, ka mite na paisak keileh, ngai in, na tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na insung ah thouhonpi ka sawl ding. Huchi in Aiguptate innte thouhonpi in adim ding, a-omna lei uh toh.
Huai ni in ka mite tenna, Goshen gam ka satkhen ding, huai a thouhonpi a-omlouhna ding in; huchi a gamsung ah kei TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding in.
Ka mite leh na mite kikal ah kikhenna ka koih ding. Zingchiang in hiai chiamtehna a-om ding hi,' " achi hi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N ahih a; Pharaoh insung leh asikhate insung leh Aigupta gam tengteng ah, thouhonpi thupitak ahong omta a; thouhonpi ziak in gam asegawp hi.
Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Pai unla, gamsung ah na Pathian kiang uah kithoihun." achi hi.

Himahleh Mosi in, "Huchibang a hih adik kei ding. TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hih ziak un. Ngai in, amuh ua Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hi uh maw, suang in ahon deng kei ding ua hia?
Gamdai ah ni thum lam ah ka pai ding uh; ahon thupiak ding bang a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna bawl ding in," achi hi.
Huan Pharaoh in, "Gamdai a TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na kithoihtheihna ding un ka hon paisak ding. Gamlapi ah pai kei peuh le uchin. Kei a ding in hon ngetsak in," achi hi.

Huan Mosi in, “Ngai in, nang a pan ka paikhe dia, Pharaoh a pan, na sikhate a pan, na mite a pan zingchiang a thouhonpi apaimang theihna ding in TOUPA ka ngen ding. Himahleh TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia amite paisak ding in lepchiahtak in Pharaoh gamta nawn kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apawtkhia a, TOUPA angenta hi.
Huan Mosi thu bang in TOUPA'N ahihta a; Pharaoh a pan leh asikhate a pan thouhonpi alamangta a; khat lel leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
Himahleh hiai hun in leng Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, mite apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
